text:
Ava (Docs): Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to update SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries across Python/TS/Go. Removing the old `cursor` pattern and clarifying retry/backoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

Marco (SDK): I can take TS + Go. Which pages should I touch?

Ava (Docs): /docs/api/streaming, /docs/guides/pagination, /docs/sdks/js-streaming.md, /docs/sdks/go-examples.md. Also a small note in /docs/reference/client-config about retry defaults.

Jin (DevEx): For Python please keep both sync and async flavors. I think an `async for chunk in resp.stream():` example is the clearest; avoid renaming methods if possible.

Marco (SDK): quick TS draft I plan to use:
```ts
const res = await sdk.responses.stream({
  model: 'rwd-large',
  input: 'Summarize the quarterly notes'
})
for await (const part of res) {
  process.stdout.write(part.output_text)
}
// res implements an async iterator; retries come from client.config.retry
```

Ava (Docs): Nice. Add an inline callout: `client.config.retry` defaults to 3 with exponential backoff. Link to /docs/reference/client-config. Also remove the old `cursor: null` from examples — it's confusing.

Sophie (ENG-ML): Add a runtime caveat: streaming + KV-cache isn't supported on quantized tiny models (e.g., rwd-small-quant), call it out under limitations.

Marco (SDK): I'll add that. Go snippet idea:
```go
resp, err := client.Responses.Stream(ctx, api.StreamRequest{
  Model: "rwd-large",
  Input: "Summarize the quarterly notes",
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for resp.Next() {
  chunk := resp.Value()
  fmt.Print(chunk.OutputText)
}
```

docs-ci-bot: link-checker found 1 broken link on /docs/guides/pagination -> old anchor `#cursor-example`. Please fix before merge.

Ava (Docs): I'll update the anchor in the PR and add the anchor-stable note to the style guide. Also pinging @Marco to remove the trailing `cursor: null` property from the JS+Go+Py examples.

Marco (SDK): noted. Branch: `docs/snippet-syncup-842`. I'll push TS+Go patches by EOD and include the runtime caveat and client-config link. Assigning reviewers @Jin @Sophie :eyes: 

Jin (DevEx): I'll add a small regression snippet to the snippets repo so doc CI can validate streaming output shape. Will do tomorrow morning.

Ava (Docs): Perfect — once CI goes green I'll merge. If anything blocks, DM me. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
